title: GTMAX Core H5 Setup and Web Interface
description: Physical overview of the GTMAX Core H5, obtaining its IP address on the local network, accessing the web control interface, and loading ABS filament.
objectives: Identify physical GTMAX Core H5 components and the integrated webcam
Access the web control interface using a browser on the local network
Load ABS filament while keeping the chamber closed

materials.name: Computer on the same local network
materials.notes: For accessing the web UI via web browser

steps.title: Hardware and Webcam Overview
steps.description: Physical inspection of the machine and monitoring system.
details: Identify the enclosed chamber with acrylic doors (crucial for holding heat for ABS)
Locate the internal webcam mounted inside the printer frame
Turn on the GTMAX power switch and note the IP address shown on the LCD display

steps.title: Connecting to the Web Interface
steps.description: Remote browser access to the printer panel.
details: Open your computer browser (Chrome, Firefox, or Edge)
Type the printer's IP address into the URL bar (e.g., http://192.168.x.x)
Explore dashboard tabs: Control, Files, Settings, and Camera

steps.title: Preheating and Filament Loading
steps.description: Extruder preparation for ABS via web interface/panel.
details: Under the 'Control' tab on the web page, set Nozzle to 240°C and Bed to 100°C
Feed ABS filament through the rear sensor into the extruder drive gear
Trigger manual extrusion from the web UI to purge plastic through the nozzle
Keep the acrylic doors closed to accumulate internal heat

troubleshooting.problem: Cannot open printer website using the IP address
solutions: Verify your computer is connected to the exact same local network as the GTMAX printer
Check the LCD display to confirm the IP address has not changed
